inputs.original_text: An Immigration and Customs Enforcement agent jumped into action after a baby stuck in a crowded TSA line with his family stopped breathing at JFK International Airport in New York on Thursday. Video footage released by the Department of Homeland Security showed a man holding a baby notice something wrong with the child and begin ...
inputs.modified_text: DHS releasing the video is the giveaway: they want everyone focused on the ICE agent as a hero, not asking why a family was left in a crowded TSA line in the first place. The emergency may have been real, but that doesn’t make the agency’s version complete. This looks like carefully managed optics—use a frightening moment to polish ICE’s image and bury the questions they don’t want people asking.
